claim: Having a tx_id is not sending. Through its state change a sprite, wall or sector sends its command only when it turns ON with trigger_on set or turns OFF with trigger_off set; a toggle lever with only trigger_on sends on every second push. The other ways out: a decoupled object sends its command each time it is triggered, without changing state; a generator sends on every repeat; and kCmdLink is sent by kSwitchCombo and by a moving sector while busy, from their own paths.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/triggers.cpp:1848-1849, 1872-1873, 1895-1896 (trTriggerSector / trTriggerWall / trTriggerSprite: decoupled sends directly); :601-603 (OperateSprite, a generator's kCmdRepeat); :491-492 (kSwitchCombo's Link); :1199, 1248 (VSpriteBusy, VDoorBusy send kCmdLink)
Secrets built with secret=True omitted trigger_on and were never counted (found 2026-11-19).
use: Declare every wire on a Circuit, which refuses a sender reporting neither change; for a toggle say on and off.

checked.how: triggers.cpp read: SetSpriteState 102-105, SetWallState 123-126, SetSectorState 140-141 and 152-153 send only on triggerOn&&state / triggerOff&&!state. But: trTriggerSector/Wall/Sprite 1848-1849, 1872-1873, 1895-1896 evSend the command directly when the object is decoupled; OperateSprite 601-603 a generator sends on every kCmdRepeat; kSwitchCombo 491-492 and the busy functions (VSpriteBusy 1199, VDoorBusy 1248, ...) send kCmdLink.
